## §4 Sub-wave dispatch instructions

### S0 — kickoff hardening (Stage 1, Mode A, ~S)

Edits **only** `.claude/orchestrator-prompts/getff-freshness-widening/kickoff.md` (+ its own PR body). Lands the seven §1 corrections:

1. **D1** — S4 scope gains the **go** lane explicitly (`setup.d/47-go.sh`, `packages/core/backends/golangci/`), matching what `done.md` routed onward. Do not silently widen — state «cargo + go» as `done.md` does.
2. **D2** — the `--refresh` framework-reconciliation gap gets **its own stage** (insert as `S4b`, after S4, before S5). **DECIDED, not open.** Rationale: (a) `done.md` routed it *into this umbrella* — descoping something the upstream deliberately handed over needs a reason, keeping it needs none; (b) the umbrella's own §1 binds «each = one PR onto staging; do NOT collapse», and S4 is already the `L`-volume stage carrying three lanes + the fixture debt — folding `--refresh` in would collapse two concerns into one PR, which is exactly what §1 forbids. A separate stage is the atomic-stage-conformant placement. Reverse this only if S0's re-plan finds `--refresh` is *already closed* by a landed trace-umbrella diff — in which case record the evidence and descope explicitly.
3. **D3** — cargo rung-5 delivery cascade named as an S4 deliverable, not folded into «mirror the agent-surface delivery».
4. **D4** — S5's «RE-RUN the one-beat cold-run protocol» → «**run** (first run; the trace umbrella parked it)» + «**on the host**, never in a container» with the `done.md` quote as its citation.
5. **D5** — S2's «byte-identity gate across ALL THREE hook copies» corrected to the mechanism that exists: edit the **source** (`packages/core/hooks/deps-hash-check.sh`), the dogfood copy (`.claude/hooks/`) is held byte-identical by `deps-hash-check.test.ts:515-527`, and `plugin/hooks/deps-hash-check` **regenerates via pre-commit** — it is not hand-edited. If the «3-way guard» claim in the hook header at `.claude/hooks/deps-hash-check.sh:2-6` is genuinely false, that is a **separate** finding to surface, not to fix inside S0.
6. **D6** — add a ```` ```bash host-verify ```` block declaring the commands that decide acceptance **on the host**.
7. **D7** — add the §4c park-don't-guess contract verbatim (Lever 2), so autonomous dispatch stops being blocked.

**Anti-scope for S0:** no code, no spec edits, no ADR edits. If S0 discovers that a correction requires a **spec** change, that is a separate spec-owner commit (precedent PR #1252) — see §5 park-record contract in `/pipeline`.

### S1–S4 (Mode-SDD / PAIR)

Each = one PR onto `staging`; **do NOT collapse** (umbrella §1). Per stage: implementer session + spec-reviewer + code-quality-reviewer (SDD role names per SSOT #64). «Works» criteria are binding per umbrella §2 — quoted lock content (S1), quoted WARN naming rule ids (S2), ledger schema exercised by **both** clients (S3), per-lane **quoted firing** with tool exit codes (S4).

**S4 domain trap is load-bearing:** T-FW-A — a lane is at parity only when its committed fixture **FIRES** (tool exit code quoted), never when the rule file merely renders.

### S5 — acceptance full + closure (Mode A, **host-only**)

The one-beat cold-run protocol (`agents/getff-cold-run-prober.md`) **must be invoked from the host** at top level (`claude --agent`), per its own §Hard constraints — the trace umbrella parked exactly this because a dispatched container worker cannot satisfy cold-start conditions #2 and #3. **A warm run reported as cold is the failure this stage exists to prevent** (spec §9.3 T-S4-C / T-AST-B). Closure writes `done.md`, which states in-file that it is the GATE for `stack-tooling-generation` (level 2).

## §4b §1.7 PR-body authoring mandate (paths-triggered, applies to ALL Workers below — self-evaluate)

Workers whose target file matches ANY of the following MUST include in the **PR body** (not just commit message): `.claude/rules/**`, `packages/core/principles/**`, `docs/meta-factory/EXECUTION-PLAN.md`, `docs/meta-factory/prior-art-evaluations.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `packages/core/templates/**`, `.claude/skills/**`, `agents/**`.

**Applies concretely here:** S3 (new ledger format → BFR consult + SSOT row + `Prior-art:` trailer per umbrella §1), S4 (`agents/rule-test-author.md`, `agents/rule-researcher.md`, `packages/core/templates/**`), S5 (`agents/getff-cold-run-prober.md`).

**Required PR body sections (verbatim shape — CI substance gate is strict):**

```markdown
### §1.7 Forward-check applied

<≥40 non-whitespace chars enumerating which existing disciplines were checked>

- `doc-authority-hierarchy.md` — <what was checked>. file:line evidence: `<path>:<line>`
- `phase-research-coverage.md §1.12` — <what was checked>. file:line evidence: `<path>:<line>`
- `build-first-reuse-default.md` — <verdict + rationale>
- `no-paid-llm-in-ci.md` — <verdict>

### §1.7 Backward-check applied

<≥40 non-whitespace chars enumerating the sweep of existing artefacts under the new rule's scope>

- `<existing-artefact-name>` — <how this PR interacts; supersedes / extends / orthogonal>. file:line evidence: `<path>:<line>`
```

**Hard rules (each has historically failed the gate):**

1. **Heading depth = H3 (`###`), NOT H2.** The awk regex matches `^### §1\.7 …`.
2. **The word «applied» is required.**
3. **≥40 non-whitespace chars in EACH section body.**
4. **≥1 file:line citation per section** matching `[^[:space:]]+\.[a-z]+:[0-9]+`.
5. **Escape hatch:** `### §1.7 Skipped: <rationale ≥60 chars>` for purely structural PRs.

**Pre-flight grep — Worker MUST run BEFORE `gh pr create`:**

```bash
echo "$PR_BODY" | grep -cE '^### §1\.7 (Forward|Backward)-check applied'  # must be 2
echo "$PR_BODY" | awk '/^### §1\.7 Forward-check applied/{c=1;next} /^###/{c=0} c' | tr -d '[:space:]' | wc -c  # ≥40
echo "$PR_BODY" | awk '/^### §1\.7 Backward-check applied/{c=1;next} /^###/{c=0} c' | tr -d '[:space:]' | wc -c  # ≥40
echo "$PR_BODY" | grep -cE '[^[:space:]]+\.[a-z]+:[0-9]+'  # ≥2
```

**Also mandatory for every stage PR:** a `## Parked questions` section (spec D4; stub already in `.github/pull_request_template.md`). Recording a fired PARK is **not** a file write — it lands in the park payload + this PR section, and its correction lands as a separate owner commit.

## §4c Autonomous aif-handoff dispatch — park-don't-guess contract

> **Status for this umbrella: BLOCKED until S0 lands D7.** Bridge is UP (`RUNTIME_BRIDGE_MODE=aif-handoff`, `http://localhost:3009` answers, `AGENT_MAX_REVIEW_ITERATIONS=1` exported), but `grep -qi 'park it as a question'` on the umbrella kickoff returns ABSENT → dispatching now is `#autonomous-dispatch-without-park`. **S5 is host-only regardless** (see §4, D4).

**Lever 1 — conservative aif config (set BEFORE dispatch):**

```bash
export AGENT_MAX_REVIEW_ITERATIONS=1        # not converged in 1 pass → hand to human, don't keep guessing
export AGENT_AUTO_REVIEW_STRATEGY=closure_first
export AGENT_SKIP_REVIEW=false
```

**Lever 2 — park-don't-guess instruction (the dispatched kickoff carries this verbatim, addressed to the aif agent):**

> **aif agent — fork discipline (non-negotiable):** On ANY genuine fork or ambiguity (two defensible implementations, an undecided design choice, a missing spec detail that changes behaviour) — **do NOT pick.** Park it as a question (set the task to `manualReviewRequired` / `blocked_external` with the fork stated as «Option A → consequence X / Option B → consequence Y») and **stop that task.** Proceed only on the unambiguous parts. Guessing a fork to "keep moving" is the failure this whole loop exists to prevent.

**Pre-dispatch gate:** `grep -qi 'park it as a question' <kickoff>` AND `echo "$AGENT_MAX_REVIEW_ITERATIONS"` non-empty. Either missing → STOP.

**Egress gate (mandatory after `status=done`):**

```bash
npx tsx packages/runtime-bridge/src/cli/harvest.ts <taskId> --base staging
```

Anti-pattern `#autonomous-done-no-harvest`: skipping this leaves the work permanently in the container.

## §5 AI-traps active (per `ai-laziness-traps.md §3`)

See `.claude/rules/ai-laziness-traps.md §2` for the full catalogue.

**Active canonical traps for getff-freshness-widening (inherited from the umbrella kickoff §3, plus meta-launch additions):** **T1, T3, T7, T13, T14, T15, T19, T21.**

- **T3** — every stage finding carries command-output or file:line + the line's actual content. The §1 drift table above is authored in this format deliberately.
- **T13** — the trace umbrella's artifacts are ADOPTED inputs here, **not** trusted ground. D5 is a live instance: the umbrella kickoff asserted a «three-copy byte-identity gate» that the test does not implement.
- **T14** — «no staleness WARN fired» on a lane ≠ freshness works there. Assert the positive case per lane or report coverage honestly.
- **T15** — S2's staleness runs against the framework repo's own generated rules as self-application.
- **T19** — own cold-QA before handoff on every stage; a green CI is form, not design.
- **T21** — the backward-check sweeps the **sibling lanes** and the level-2 seam consumers, never the diff's own files. Delegate to `agents/backward-sweep-auditor.md` with the change's *class* only.

**Domain-specific traps (getff-freshness-widening-specific, NOT in the canonical catalogue):**

- **T-FW-A** (from the umbrella) — declaring parity by **RENDER**, not **FIRE**: a lane is «at parity» only when its committed fixture FIRES (tool exit code quoted), not when the rule file renders. Counter: umbrella §2 requires per-lane quoted firing.
- **T-FW-B (meta-launch addition)** — **reporting a warm run as the cold run.** S5's one-beat protocol has never executed (the trace umbrella parked it); the path of least resistance is to run it from inside the dispatched session, which structurally cannot be cold (the agent inherits the framework repo as ambient context and knows it is being probed). Tempted output: «cold-run protocol: GREEN». Counter: S5 is host-only, invoked at top level, and a run that cannot meet cold-start conditions #2/#3 is **parked again**, never manufactured.
- **T-FW-C (meta-launch addition)** — **treating a routed-onward item as closed because the upstream `done.md` mentioned it.** `done.md` names four items it explicitly did NOT do (`--refresh`, cargo rung-5, cargo/go rungs, cell-full); the temptation is to read the naming as handling. Counter: §1 D1–D3 assign each a stage or an explicit named descope with rationale — «mentioned upstream» is never a closure basis.

## §7 Phase -1 reviewer dispatch (between stages)

Before dispatching Stage N+1, invoke:

```text
Agent: Phase -1 cold-review for getff-freshness-widening Stage N
Role: reviewer
Skill: requesting-code-review
```

Reviewer discipline: surfaces strategy forks as DECISION-NEEDED (option A → consequence X / option B → consequence Y). Does NOT pick strategy. Does NOT edit files. Does NOT skip surface review because CI is green (T19). See `reviewer-discipline.md §2`.

**Verdict routing:** GO → dispatch Stage N+1 · REVISE → surface findings, worker fixes, repeat Phase -1 · STOP → escalate, halt.

**Re-probe for in-flight work immediately after each Phase -1 completes, before the actual dispatch** (CLAUDE.md pre-dispatch in-flight probe — all three historical collisions materialized inside the Phase -1 window).

## §8 Stop conditions

- `bash scripts/host-verify.sh getff-freshness-widening` still fails after S0 → halt; S1 must not dispatch.
- Any stage-gate `gh pr list` returns empty while Stage N was expected merged → halt, report.
- Phase -1 reviewer returns STOP → halt, surface to maintainer.
- Any sub-wave returns a BLOCKER finding → halt the Stage; surface before proceeding.
- S5's cold-run cannot meet cold-start conditions #2/#3 → **park it again**; do NOT report a warm run as cold.
- Any `gh` command errors while parallel sub-waves are in flight → halt, escalate.
- Any temptation to edit `~/.claude/skills/orchestrator/` → T-MOB-C violation; stop.
